referenceDevice: BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988, Filogic) — tri-band Wi-Fi 7 EasyMesh extender

partitions.purpose: Early boot stage (BL2 A). Raw boot payload, present.
Firmware Image Package (FIP A). Raw boot payload, present.
Active BootFS (VFAT) — kernel image + DTB. Measured 7.44 MiB used of 15.95 MiB (47%).

Active RootFS (ext4) containing Core RDK-B components; no WAN stack loaded for this profile. Measured 221.44 MiB used of 957.42 MiB filesystem capacity (25%; base 220.96 MiB + overlay 0.50 MiB), clean production-representative image (BUILD_TYPE=dev label present, but no development toolchains found in the filesystem).
Passive RootFS — allocated, no filesystem present (uninitialized). Slot B is an upgrade target that has not yet received a firmware image, not a populated standby.
Shared persistent configuration (PSM/TR-181), single partition, no separate A/B. Measured 0.28 MiB used of 13.74 MiB capacity (3%).
Slot-A crash/debug capture — allocated, no filesystem present (uninitialized).
Slot-B crash/debug capture — allocated, no filesystem present (uninitialized).
DAC partition — allocated, no filesystem present (uninitialized).

notes: Partition names, allocations, and filesystem types are measured directly from a Filogic tri-band extender reference device — see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 3.7.1. Total allocated across all 13 partitions is 2,172 MiB, well within the 4,096 MB (4 GB) minFlashMB floor (Section 3, CRF-002) with room to spare. rootfs_a's 221.44 MiB confirms the extender genuinely needs less flash than the gateway (no WAN stack), not more. An earlier measurement on a separate, dev-SDK-contaminated image showed 1.7 GiB used (Go/Rust/LLVM/GCC/headers/debug packages, over 1 GiB of toolchain alone); that figure is superseded by this clean result. MAC address storage has no partition here — see ethwan-wifi-router.flash-layout.json notes for the shared board-level explanation.
